name: AccessFlow
description: Self-hosted portal to manage users, subscriptions and invites for a personal Plex server: roles, plans, renewals, payment reports, email/Telegram reminders. Requires APP_SECRET_KEY (>=32 random chars) and, to invite/manage Plex users, PLEX_TOKEN + PLEX_SERVER_NAME. Put the app behind a reverse proxy (NPM/SWAG/Traefik) and set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to your https:// URL.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: SQLite DB + backups + secrets. Container Path: /data

variables.name: App Secret Key
variables.description: REQUIRED. Random string >=32 chars, the app refuses to start without it. Generate: python -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))"

variables.name: Public Base URL
variables.description: Your public https:// URL (through the reverse proxy). Needed for Secure session cookies.

variables.name: Forwarded Allow IPs
variables.description: Reverse proxy source IP/subnet uvicorn trusts for X-Forwarded-*. Never "*" if exposed directly. Unraid docker bridge is typically 172.17.0.0/16.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for schedules/reminders/backups.

variables.name: Default Locale
variables.description: UI language (it/en).

variables.name: SuperAdmin Username
variables.description: Local login username, seeded on first boot.

variables.name: SuperAdmin Password
variables.description: Leave blank: a random password is generated and logged once at first boot (change it later from /profile).

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Admin Plex token, used for invites + OAuth. https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436

variables.name: Plex Server Name
variables.description: Name of the Plex server to manage.

variables.name: Plex Direct URL
variables.description: Optional: connect straight to this Plex baseurl (plex.direct dashed-host form), skipping plex.tv discovery. Leave blank for normal discovery.

variables.name: Plex Client ID
variables.description: Optional: stable Plex client identifier. Derived from the secret key if left blank.

variables.name: Plex Revoke On Delete
variables.description: Revoke the user's Plex server access when their AccessFlow account is deleted.

variables.name: Telegram Bot Token
variables.description: Optional: enables the Telegram reminder bot. From @BotFather.

variables.name: Telegram Bot Username
variables.description: Bot username (without @), used for deep links.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: Optional: enables email reminders.

variables.name: SMTP From
variables.description: From address for reminder emails.

variables.name: SMTP From Name
variables.description: Display name in the From header.

variables.name: Notify Hour
variables.description: Hour (0-23, server TZ) the daily expiration scan + reminders run.

variables.name: Reminder Days Before
variables.description: Comma-separated days-before-expiry to send reminders. Admin-editable in Settings too.

variables.name: Reminder Days After
variables.description: Comma-separated overdue days for dunning follow-ups. Admin-editable in Settings too.

variables.name: Digest Lookahead Days
variables.description: Manager weekly-digest lookahead window in days. Admin-editable in Settings too.

variables.name: Backup Keep
variables.description: How many nightly SQLite backups to keep.

variables.name: Enable Scheduler
variables.description: Run the daily reminder/backup scheduler in-process.

variables.name: Enable Telegram Bot
variables.description: Run the Telegram bot (polling) in-process.
